purpose: Teach: 申し込み/専攻/子会社/持ち主/一環/一括/圧縮/復旧

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新規取引の、本気で、絶対、申し込み、絶対、対応、絶対、迅速にしろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: New client applications — I need them handled swiftly. This is urgent. Don't mess this up.
lines.style: Clipped, businesslike. Sharp attack on first phrase. Measured pace, no breath for hesitation. Final sentence drops slightly in pitch — absolute confidence, not anger.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人の、本気で、絶対、専攻、絶対、分野、絶対、活かす、絶対、配属、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're assigning the new recruits to divisions that match their strengths, and moving that forward. Thank you for the clear direction.
lines.style: Respectful, steady. Measured delivery without stammering. Slight emphasis on 'moving forward' — showing competence. The gratitude is genuine, not performative.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 海外、本気で、絶対、子会社、絶対、業績、絶対、確認しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Check the performance numbers on our overseas subsidiaries. I need that information today.
lines.style: Flat, direct instruction. No softening. Opens crisp. Steady pace throughout — this is baseline expectation, not punishment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古いビルの、本気で、絶対、持ち主、絶対、と、絶対、交渉、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're currently in negotiations with the building owners about the older property, and we're moving ahead on that front. Thank you for your guidance.
lines.style: Confident, slightly more relaxed than before. Shows progress. Rhythm matches the pace of work being done — steady, no rushing. The 'thank you' feels earned.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 環境対策の、本気で、絶対、一環、絶対、新製品、絶対、開発しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: As part of our environmental initiatives, I want a new product developed. Make it happen.
lines.style: Authoritative but not loud. Strategic pause after the reasoning — showing this is thought-through. Final sentence is an absolute, delivered with quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様の発注、本気で、絶対、一括、絶対、対応、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're consolidating our major clients' orders and handling them as a unified response. Thank you for that priority.
lines.style: Engaged, slightly warmer. Shows understanding of the strategy behind the instruction. Pace picks up slightly on 'unified response' — confidence building. Gratitude feels reciprocal.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 倉庫の、本気で、絶対、圧縮、絶対、保管、絶対、効率化しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Streamline our warehouse operations. Better storage compression, better efficiency. I want to see results.
lines.style: Sharp, purposeful. Opens with energy. Builds slightly through the middle — momentum. Final sentence is calm but non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。システムの、本気で、絶対、復旧、絶対、迅速に、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're prioritizing the system recovery and pushing that through quickly. Thank you for your leadership on this.
lines.style: Engaged and closing strong. Slight rise on 'quickly' — showing urgency is heard and matched. Final phrase carries warmth without undermining professionalism. Slight exhale at the very end.
